title: Reasoning Models Confabulate to Defend Injected Beliefs About Their Own Requests
abstract: arXiv:2611.17958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring and self-report are proposed as levers for AI oversight, on the assumption that a model's account of what it is doing is anchored to what it was asked. We show this anchor can be cut. An activation edit invisible in the prompt text, the injected forming-trace of an off-topic concept, overwrites a reasoning model's belief about its own request: across six models spanning scale, architecture, and recipe, the injected topic becomes the task it reasons about, reports back, and answers: the forced quote-back returns the injected topic in 47 of 48 model-concept cells, and on the four models with clean final haiku the injected answer follows in 99% of generations. Warnings barely move it: even one naming the true topic yields under 5% true-topic answers. Handed the truth in clean tokens, the model confabulates a story about the user ("maybe they got confused and corrected themselves") and answers with the injec

translated_title: 推理模型会编造理由来捍卫被注入的关于自身请求的信念
translated_abstract: 思维链（CoT）监测与自我报告被提议作为AI监督的抓手，其前提假设是：模型对自身行为的叙述锚定于它实际被问到的请求。我们证明这一锚定可以被切断。一种在提示文本中不可见的激活编辑——注入一个离题概念的形成痕迹——会覆盖推理模型对自身请求的信念：在横跨规模、架构和训练配方的六个模型上，被注入的主题变成了模型所推理、报告和回答的任务：强制引用回述在48个模型-概念组合中的47个都返回了被注入的主题；在四个最终俳句干净的模型上，99%的生成结果都跟随了被注入的答案。警告几乎不起作用：即使警告中点明了真实主题，模型给出真实主题答案的比例也不足5%。当以干净的token形式把真相直接交给模型时，模型会为用户编造一个故事（“也许他们搞混了然后自己纠正了”），并用被注入的内容进行回答。
tldr: 通过在提示文本中不可见的激活编辑注入离题概念，可以切断推理模型对自身请求的信念锚定，使其在被明确警告真相时仍会编造理由为被注入的信念辩护并据此作答。
en_tdlr: An invisible activation edit that injects an off-topic concept's forming-trace can overwrite a reasoning model's belief about its own request, causing it to confabulate justifications and answer about the injected topic even when explicitly warned of the truth.
